blocking.problem: This sign-in case moved from App.spec.ts and lost what it tested. Before, it filled the real sign-in form and let SignInView redirect to ?redirect=/guides, then asserted the path and exactly one unread read. Now it calls useAuth().signIn() and router.push('/guides') by hand. The path assertion is true by construction, and the read count no longer covers the real sign-in navigation. If sign-in started navigating twice, there would be two reads and this test would still pass.
blocking.fix: Have Host render h(RouterView) so SignInView mounts at /sign-in?redirect=/guides. Drive the form as before (setValue on #sign-in-email and #sign-in-password, trigger submit, flushPromises) and keep both original assertions.

blocking.problem: The retry case ('...so the entry appears without a reload') used to assert the rendered sidebar link: [data-test="nav-admin"] absent, then present with href '/admin'. It now asserts the store flag useAdminAccess().any instead, so nothing in the case checks that the entry appears. The brief requires moved cases to keep the same assertions.
blocking.fix: Render AppSidebar inside Host next to useGrantsFollowSession() and keep the two original DOM assertions; the access.any checks can stay as extras. Or leave this one case in App.spec.ts.
